questions.question: Read the following statement carefully and identify the conclusion that follows. Statement: No student of Class X failed the science exam this year. Conclusions: I. The science exam was very easy. II. All students of Class X passed science.
questions.questionHtml:
Read the following statement carefully and identify the conclusion that follows.

Statement: No student of Class X failed the science exam this year.

Conclusions:

I. The science exam was very easy.

II. All students of Class X passed science.
questions.solution:
Conclusions:

I. The science exam was very easy - False  (Even if no one failed, it doesn’t prove the exam was easy.
Students might have prepared well, or grading may have been lenient.).

II. All students of Class X passed science - True (If no student failed, it logically means all students passed.).

So, Only Conclusion II follows

questions.question: A 60 L mixture has a milk-water ratio of 7:3. How much water to add to make the ratio 1:1?
questions.questionHtml: A 60 L mixture has a milk-water ratio of 7:3. How much water to add to make the ratio 1:1?
questions.solution:
Find total parts: 7 + 3 = 10 parts

Quantity of milk = (7 / 10) × 60 = 42 L

Quantity of water = (3 / 10) × 60 = 18 L

For ratio 1 : 1 ⇒ Milk = Water

Milk is already 42 L, so water must also be 42 L.

Water to be added = 42 − 18 = 24 L

questions.question: If 11 / 19 = A and 2 / 9 = B, then what is A - B?
questions.questionHtml: If 11 / 19 = A and 2 / 9 = B, then what is A - B?
questions.solution:
A − B = (11/19) − (2/9)

Take LCM of 19 and 9:
19 × 9 = 171

Now convert into like fractions:

(11 × 9 − 2 × 19) / 171

= (99 − 38) / 171

= 61 / 171

Now convert to decimal:

61 ÷ 171 ≈ 0.356 ≈ 0.36

∴ The correct answer is "Option 1."
